The Referee decides to give a black card. Under Clause 5.17.5 (5.17 Misconduct) of Instructions to Technical Officials 7.0 (5), in force 2025-04-26, when the Referee decides to disqualify the offending player or pair of players, a black card is given to the Umpire.
